# Sci-Hub

> Sci-Hub is a free open access platform providing unrestricted access to millions of scientific research papers and academic publications.

Founded by Alexandra Elbakyan, Sci-Hub operates as a grassroots open access movement initiative, maintaining a comprehensive database of research documents with global usage statistics and cryptocurrency-based support mechanisms. The platform serves researchers worldwide by bypassing traditional academic publishing paywalls.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Movement
- Scientific Research Papers

## Core Platform

- [Sci-Hub Homepage](https://www.tesble.com): Sci-Hub homepage: free scientific papers and research article downloads
- [About Sci-Hub](https://tesble.com/about): About Sci-Hub: mission, open access movement, and legal position information
- [Database Overview](https://tesble.com/database): Sci-Hub database overview with statistics and metadata on research documents collection

## Organization & Leadership

- [Alexandra Elbakyan](https://tesble.com/alexandra): Biography of Alexandra Elbakyan, Sci-Hub founder and open access advocate

## Analytics & Insights

- [Usage Statistics](https://tesble.com/stats): Sci-Hub usage statistics and download analytics by country and metrics

## Support & Contributions

- [Donate to Sci-Hub](https://tesble.com/donate): Sci-Hub donation methods via Bitcoin, Ethereum, Monero and cryptocurrencies

## Research Papers

- [IGF-1-induced MMP-11 Expression in Gastric Cancer](https://tesble.com/10.3892/ol.2018.8234): Research paper on IGF-1 and MMP-11 expression in gastric cancer cells
- [Reactive Attachment Disorder and Attachment Theory](https://tesble.com/10.1080/14616734.2018.1499214): Academic paper on reactive attachment disorder and attachment theory development
- [HPV Vaccination, Screening, and Associated Disease](https://tesble.com/10.1007/s11606-016-3725-z): Medical research update on HPV vaccination and cervical cancer screening
- [Pneumococcal DnaJ and Dendritic Cell Immune Responses](https://tesble.com/10.1016/j.imbio.2016.08.013): Immunology research on pneumococcal DnaJ and dendritic cell immune responses

## Optional

- [Biologia Centrali-Americana: Central America Fauna and Flora](https://tesble.com/10.1038/069338a0): Historical scientific publication on fauna, flora and archaeology of Central America
- [Consumer Survey on Edible Insects](https://tesble.com/10.1108/bfj-01-2019-0017): Consumer survey research on species preferences for edible insect acceptance
- [O-Alkylation of Isovanillin Under Phase-Transfer Catalysis](https://tesble.com/10.1021/op800058n): Chemistry research on phase-transfer catalysis and isovanillin scale-up synthesis
- [Bamberger Rearrangement in CO2–H2O System](https://tesble.com/10.1021/ie500864p): Industrial chemistry paper on Bamberger rearrangement and organic synthesis
- [Hypertension and High Altitude Acclimatization](https://tesble.com/10.1038/s41371-018-0037-2): Epidemiological study on hypertension and high altitude acclimatization risk factors
- [Rough Set Reducts and Typical Testors](https://tesble.com/10.1016/j.ins.2014.09.045): Computer science paper on rough set theory and feature selection methods
- [Bacillus megaterium Genome Sequences](https://tesble.com/10.1128/jb.00449-11): Genomics research on Bacillus megaterium bacterial strains and biotechnology
- [Protein Folding of Horse Cytochrome c](https://tesble.com/10.1006/jmbi.2001.4993): Biochemistry research on protein folding of horse cytochrome c
- [Deforestation and Land-Use Change in Southwest Nigeria](https://tesble.com/10.1007/978-3-319-71025-9_139-1): Handbook chapter on deforestation and land-use change drivers in Nigeria
